phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C4 — Eurostat Detailed-Sector Dissemination Audit
purpose: Test whether Eurostat's own BPM6 quarterly BOP/IIP dissemination publishes Romania F2 currency-and-deposits assets separately for S11 and S1M where ECB BPS publishes only the combined S1V sector.
required_checks: S11 stock observation exists for 2025-Q4 in at least one official Eurostat unit
S1M stock observation exists for 2025-Q4 in the same unit
S1V = S11 + S1M reconciles within published precision
S1P/S12M/S1V and total-sector controls are cross-checked against the prior ECB BPS structure
quarterly transaction dissemination is inspected independently in bop_c6_q and its available stk_flow categories are recorded rather than assumed
all raw Eurostat JSON-stat responses used in the audit are retained with SHA-256
promotion_rule: A positive source-coverage result only authorizes a later concept-and-vintage reconciliation gate. It does not authorize insertion into the ESA/QSA Accounting Spine.
negative_result_rule: If S11 and S1M observations are not both published for Romania F2, the H/C split remains unresolved and S1V must not be allocated synthetically.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting/source audit only; no feedback, delay, nonlinearity or behavioural-closure status changes.
